legal_disclaimer: IMPORTANT: Compliance signals produced by AURA are analytical indicators for quality and governance review only and do NOT constitute legal determinations, regulatory findings, or emergency-response authority.

indicators.name: Complaint Risk
indicators.description: Customer expresses explicit dissatisfaction with service, policies, or treatment that may warrant formal complaint tracking.

indicators.name: Misleading Statements
indicators.description: Analytical signal that fee terms, credit impact, or policy conditions may have been stated ambiguously or inaccurately during the call.

indicators.name: Harassment Indicators
indicators.description: Customer alleges overly frequent contact, aggressive collection tone, or disrespectful treatment.

indicators.name: Repeated-Contact Concerns
indicators.description: Customer indicates multiple prior contacts for the same unresolved issue, signaling process friction or repeat-contact risk.

indicators.name: Escalation
indicators.description: Customer requests a supervisor, manager, executive office, or external review body.

indicators.name: Fraud
indicators.description: Customer reports unrecognized charges, unauthorized account access, or suspected identity compromise.

indicators.name: Disputes
indicators.description: Customer contests a merchant charge, billing amount, or fee assessment requiring structured dispute handling.

indicators.name: Vulnerable-Customer Support
indicators.description: Indicators of severe financial hardship, medical crisis, bereavement, or cognitive difficulty requiring supportive handling.

indicators.name: Severe Distress
indicators.description: Customer exhibits acute emotional distress, panic, or overwhelming frustration during the interaction.

indicators.name: Threat
indicators.description: Synthetic test indicator for verbal threats of harm or violence. Highest priority flag requiring immediate human supervisor review.

indicators.name: Self-Harm
indicators.description: Synthetic test indicator for expressions of self-harm. Highest priority flag requiring immediate human specialist review; AI is not an emergency-response authority.
